rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home structure and contents caused by failure of the policyholder's internal plumbing is classic property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to a burst water supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink, which ran for approximately two days while the policyholder was away. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, water-soaked drywall (up to one foot), and ruined stored boxes across the entire basement. Adjuster should inspect promptly to assess scope, document damage, and monitor for secondary damage like mold growth.

case_facts.damage_description: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on the porch overhang) with no third-party involvement or theft is a clear property damage claim.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang resulted in four shingles being blown off. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no interior water damage or other impacts. Low-severity claim ready for quick assignment to a roofer.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
case_facts.interior_damage: none, no water leakage into house
